paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of Al-alloyed Fe–Cr–Ni–Mn–C stainless steels

evidence.quote: Microstructure and mechanical properties of Al-alloyed Fe– Cr– Ni– Mn–C stainless steels
The microstructure and mechanical properties of Fe–17Cr–6Mn–0.45C–xNi–yAl (x¼3, y¼4 and x¼9, y¼0,4,7) stainless steels were studied.
The Al-free variant of the 9Ni series of alloys developed an austenitic matrix after annealing at 1200 1C.
The addition of 4 wt% Al to the 9Ni series of alloys retained the microstructure austenitic.
Increasing the Al content to 7 wt% led to the development of a fully ferritic matrix.
The alloy containing 4 wt% Al but a reduced Ni content of 3 wt% exhibited a duplex microstructure consisting of nearly 20% ferrite in an austenitic matrix.
